user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.description: Comprehensive test covering the user login process from entering credentials to accessing the dashboard
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that users can successfully log in to access the dashboard
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As an authorized user, I want to log in to the website so that I can access organizational tools and data securely

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage and verify the URL is correct
detailed_steps.business_impact: Ensures the site is accessible and ready for login

detailed_steps.description: Insert the username into the username input field
detailed_steps.verification_point: Username input field contains the entered value
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows the user to provide authentication details

detailed_steps.description: Insert the password into the password input field
detailed_steps.verification_point: Password input field contains the entered value
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows the user to complete authentication credentials

detailed_steps.description: Submit the login form by clicking the login button
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page URL changes to /home after login
detailed_steps.business_impact: Authenticates the user and grants access to the dashboard

expected_results: User successfully logs in and transitions to the dashboard page
All login-related UI elements function correctly
System handles login workflow without errors
edge_cases_to_test: What happens when incorrect credentials are entered
How the system behaves if the login button is clicked multiple times
What happens if the user navigates away mid-login
How the system handles slow internet during login
data_requirements: Valid test user accounts with known credentials
Access to the Salesforce environment for testing
prerequisites: Test accounts are pre-configured in the system
No issues with the Salesforce backend during testing
